name: Titles And Names Of The Devil
overview: Scripture reveals the devil through various titles that emphasize his deceptive, adversarial, and destructive nature. From the serpent's lie to Eve in Genesis 3:4, to Satan's role as the adversary who stands against God's people in 1 Chronicles 21:1, the Bible portrays him as a liar, accuser, and tempter. The presence of an evil and lying spirit sent to trouble and deceive, as seen in 1 Samuel 16:14 and 1 Kings 22:22, further underscores his role as the enemy who opposes God's purposes and brings sorrow and death.
